notes: Speech boundary repair for Hy-MT2 and Argos: when a long/aged English chunk contains complete earlier sentences but a clipped tail (e.g. 'cashflow prop'), translate the complete portion promptly, retain the tail for next recognition and conservatively reconcile with a complete recognized next word (e.g. 'problem'). Never invent words. Whisper ASR model and source-only Hy-MT2 translation prompt are unchanged. This does not fix true Whisper misrecognitions or literal business idioms. Windows syntax/full regression tests passed pre-release; no EXE or model download.
